title: Integral naturality of the explicit completed tensor comparison
statement: At a fixed finite coefficient field E and a single finite model N, the explicit completedTensorIntegralComponent components, on pairs of integral constructible objects, form a natural isomorphism between the tensor of the two realized objects and realization of their rational derived tensor. The isomorphism has exactly the specified components; no data is chosen from an unproved existence theorem.

source.place: BS Definition 3.4.10 and Remark 6.8.15; HRS Proposition 5.2 and Lemma 7.9; the corresponding part of the finite normalized realization argument.

proof.text: Evaluate the prescribed bilinear action of rational derived tensor on localized integral arrows at scalar coefficients 1 and 1. This gives heterogeneous equality with localization of the integral tensor map. The equality-induced tensorIntegralObjectIso therefore satisfies its naturality equation, by conjugation with eqToHom. Paste this natural isomorphism with the integral realization comparison, inverse ordinary tensor comparison, and natural quotient-completion comparison. Expanding the components of the pasted natural isomorphism gives the definition of completedTensorIntegralComponent.

theorem completedTensorIntegralComponent_natural_iso
    (E : AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Index l (PadicAlgCl l))
    (N : CompletedTensorFiniteModel l X R closed models E) :
    let q := sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l
      (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E) X
    let I := GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion
      (l := l) (Ω := PadicAlgCl l) (Y := X) E
    let F := ((ordinary l X R).prod (ordinary l X R)) ⋙ closed.tensor
    let G := rationalDerivedTensor l
      (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E) X ⋙ I ⋙ ordinary l X R
    ∃ e : (q.prod q) ⋙ (I.prod I) ⋙ F ≅ (q.prod q) ⋙ G,
      ∀ P, e.hom.app P =
        (completedTensorIntegralComponent l X R closed models E N P.1 P.2).hom
